'''Ulal''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who, unlike most members of his [[Species/Legends|species]], enjoyed spending time in space. Ulal commanded the ''[[Potala Um Var]]'', which he used to patrol the space around [[Varl/Legends|Varl]]. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Ulal had spent around 500 years patrolling the region.<ref name="LoNH" />
